degradation_evidence.before: Only libFLAC was fuzzed via library API; command-line tool was untested by OSS-Fuzz
degradation_evidence.after: New tool_flac.c harness added exposing CLI argument parsing (API), file I/O state management (State), and command-line option combinations (Configuration)
degradation_evidence.impact: Adding a new fuzzer target exposes three new dimensions simultaneously

gap_introduced.description: New fuzzer for CLI tool introduces API (arg parsing), State (file handles), and Configuration (option combinations) dimensions at once
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - old harness only covered libFLAC; new tool_flac harness required to cover CLI paths

mix_rationale.api: CLI argument parsing introduces a new API surface (argc/argv interface vs library calls)
mix_rationale.state: File I/O in CLI tool introduces open/read/close lifecycle state not present in library fuzzer
mix_rationale.configuration: Command-line options (--compression-level, --verify, --decode) create a configuration space the old harness did not exercise

rationale: Adding a CLI fuzzer is a mix degradation because it simultaneously introduces three new fuzzing dimensions that the original library harness did not cover.

verification.method: Code inspection of tool_flac.c and main.c changes
